_comment: Cases for scripts/test-composition-architecture.py. `compositions` are krateo-057 objects (2026-09-26,
read-only): the composition and its managed objects, managedFields dropped and the objects' spec
dropped (no program reads it). The architecture ConfigMap is not a fixture: the runner renders
helm/builder-publish for the composition, as CDC does, so the chart's own output feeds the RESTAction.
Each case mutates that cluster the way a real caller meets it; `proves` says what it pins.

cases.name: demo
cases.proves: A finished composition, with the ConfigMap and every other managed object served from snowplow's informer (no apiVersion, no kind): S4 change-request-open, all ready, joined by name.

cases.name: v1b
cases.proves: The live v1b: S2 seeding, waiting on the Repo, which is NotSynced (ReconcileError); the files and the PR are withheld, and not fetched.

cases.name: v1b-cdc-extras
cases.proves: CDC's extras (compositionName, compositionNamespace, compositionId) read exactly as the page's.

cases.name: v1b-denied-repository
cases.proves: A caller denied the Repository by snowplow's own RBAC re-gate (a Forbidden string): the rendered Repo proves the Repository was ready at the last render, so it is done, inferred, and says it is not readable.

cases.name: v1b-denied-current
cases.proves: A caller denied the current node by the apiserver (a 403 Status, which snowplow keeps without `details`): the Repo is unreadable, named from the message, and the level is still known.

cases.name: v1b-current-deleted
cases.proves: The current node is gone (404) though status.managed still lists it: it is waiting, not unreadable.

cases.name: v1b-current-dropped
cases.proves: The current node was served with no error and nothing in it (an informer drop): unavailable, 'could not be read'.

cases.name: v1b-current-failed
cases.proves: The current node's read never got an answer (a 500 with no object name in it): unavailable, never 'not readable with your access'.

cases.name: demo-denied-two-files
cases.proves: Two of ten files denied: the rendered PullRequest proves all ten were ready, so the files are done, inferred, and the composition is still all ready.

cases.name: composition-forbidden
cases.proves: The composition itself is denied: readable is false, every present node is unknown, and no object is fetched.

cases.name: configmap-forbidden
cases.proves: The ConfigMap is denied by the apiserver: no architecture, access forbidden.

cases.name: configmap-denied-by-snowplow
cases.proves: The ConfigMap is denied by snowplow's RBAC re-gate (a Forbidden string, the shape an informer-served kind gets from snowplow >= 1.12.14): access forbidden.

cases.name: no-configmap
cases.proves: No ConfigMap (404): no architecture, and no claim about access.

cases.name: label-mismatch
cases.proves: A ConfigMap of that name that another composition rendered is not this composition's architecture.

cases.name: no-extras
cases.proves: No extras: no architecture (the call goes to a name that cannot exist).

cases.name: empty-descriptor
cases.proves: A chart that declares no resources: nodes [], all ready, level null, and nothing to draw.

gate.name: v1b-rendered
gate.proves: Once the chart renders its ConfigMap, status.managed lists it and the card shows.

gate.name: v1b-today
gate.proves: Before the chart ships architecture.yaml (057 today): nothing renders, composition-architecture is never called.

gate.name: no-architecture
gate.proves: A composition that manages ConfigMaps, none of them its architecture: nothing renders.

gate.name: not-found
gate.proves: composition-detail cannot resolve the composition for this caller: nothing renders, like the rest of the page.
